name: Application security engineer
summary: Checks a business's own code and settings for common security gaps and writes the fixes with tests. Readies small apps for a customer's security questions.

changelog.note: First release: role knowledge with 30 sources (OWASP Top 10:2025, ASVS 5.0, cheat sheets, CVSS 4.0, EPSS, CISA KEV, RFC 9116, CRA reporting, GitHub, npm, pip-audit, ZAP), four skills, five prompts, three workflows, training. No scanning or testing without written authorisation and scope; no secrets in chat.
